title_zh: 保加利亚、希腊和罗马尼亚签署联合行动计划加快战略交通连接建设
title_original: Bulgaria, Greece and Romania step up delivery of strategic transport links
summary_zh: 2026年10月9日，保加利亚、希腊和罗马尼亚在布鲁塞尔“连接欧洲日2026”期间签署联合行动计划，将2025年12月的政治承诺转化为具体行动，加快东南欧跨境交通项目落地。计划聚焦三国间优先交通轴线，包括铁路和公路连接、多瑙河跨河通道及港口与多式联运码头衔接。重点项目涵盖希腊亚历山德鲁波利斯港至保加利亚斯维伦格勒的跨境铁路、久尔久-鲁塞铁路桥现代化改造、新建久尔久-鲁塞公铁两用桥前期准备，以及三国间其他关键铁路和公路改善工程。同日还启动了“东南欧之友”倡议以支持区域互联互通合作。
source_name: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司
content_evidence: Bulgaria, Greece and Romania today signed a joint Action Plan to accelerate strategic cross-border transport projects in South-East Europe. The signing ceremony took place in the margins of Connecting Europe Days 2026 in Brussels, hosted by Apostolos Tzitzikostas, European Commissioner for Sustainable Transport and Tourism. The Action Plan turns the political commitments made by the three countries in December 2025 into concrete actions, supporting the faster delivery of key infrastructure projects, stronger connectivity and greater resilience across the region. The Action Plan will strengthen coordination on project preparation, financing and implementation, helping to remove cross-border bottlenecks and accelerate improvements to rail, road and multimodal connections across the region.
